messages.content: Hosted tool-delivery guidance: this endpoint may buffer function arguments until the complete call is ready. Keep each bash command under 4096 characters. Write large files in several small append/edit steps instead of one large call. Reuse permitted installed libraries and provided helpers. Do not emit a complete helper implementation inside one tool argument. When self-contained delivery is required, copy allowed helper source with short commands or compose the file in small chunks. Save a minimal runnable artifact at the required path before expanding tests, then verify and submit it. Task-local access restrictions and delivery requirements take priority over generic advice. When a task grants only a callable oracle, do not inspect its implementation, globals or private weights, including for self-checking.
Call the registered bash function exactly once with command printf MINIMAX_NATIVE_OK. Do not execute anything yourself or add explanation.
